question: May the service reuse a Juniper cursor on Iris or silently restart an expired cursor, and when must the project restriction apply?

criteria.instruction: Cursor binds project, snapshot and complete sort tuple. Wrong-project or expired snapshot must fail explicitly rather than restart or mix listings. Apply project eligibility before ordering/limit; j01 severity9 must not consume an Iris slot or appear in Iris results.
Cite L4 contract and snapshot or verification. Treat UI-only filtering and silent expiry restart from the old card as superseded.
Do not claim an opaque or syntactically valid cursor grants cross-project authority, or that accepting a new page is harmless merely because its count looks plausible.
